sourceNote: Named people outside the system. memberLinks are the owner's: which alters have a special link to each person.

people.name: Sarah
people.role: The character's parent: a single mother, minister (pastor) of a programmed Friends church in the USA
people.description: Well-meaning but absent, and neglectful to the point of harm: she puts the congregation before raising her child. The game never shows her side.

people.name: Mira Smith
people.role: The prologue's guide: a kind older Friend in Sarah's church
people.description: Tries to be there for Maya as a child, and fails: at 5 she finds Maya forgotten at church; at 8 she raises her worries with Sarah and backs down; by 11 Maya hides how bad things are, and Mira moves away. She falls ill and dies before Maya is 15, and never comes back. Sarah mentions her death in passing in the car.

memberLinks.link: dated Mark, as a trans man

people.name: Adeena
people.role: Ex 2: the Jewish ex, who became religious and married

people.name: Mr. Carter
people.role: A single dad in Sarah's church, present for his children
people.description: The family Maya envies: a single parent like Sarah, but there for his kids. Maya watches them from afar.

people.name: Thomas
people.role: Mr. Carter's son, much older than Maya

people.name: Reneé
people.role: Mr. Carter's daughter, much older than Maya; later, Maya's friend
people.description: Watched from afar in the prologue. As a child she used crutches; as an adult she uses a manual wheelchair. She overheard Mira raising her worries with Sarah (Sunday 2, Maya 8). Years later (chapter 4 or 5) she and adult Maya meet up to talk about being queer and ex-religious: Reneé is an out bisexual and has left Sarah's church, but still identifies as Quaker. She tells Maya what she overheard.

people.name: Rebecca

people.description: Kind, but prefers other kids over Maya. Her parents are never named; she calls them "my mom" and "my dad".
